title: Amazon SNS to Amazon SQS fanout pattern
description: Fanout pattern using Amazon SNS and Amazon SQS. Subscription filters are used to route SNS topics to the the correct SQS queue.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Three SQS queues subscribe to the SNS topic. The topic routing logic is defined through the subscription filter policy.
The AllMetricsSqsQueue queue receives all the messages. The TemperatureSqsQueue queue receives Temperature messages and the HumiditySqsQueue queue receives Humidity messages.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
